Notchivity UX review

10 council rounds. Overall scores went from 7 / 7 / 6.5 to 9 / 9 / 9, the target, in round 10.

Three cold reviewers each round: Opus (high effort) on design and scope, Opus (medium) on fit with DESIGN.md and PRODUCT.md, Sonnet on defects. Each scored 8 categories from 1 to 10, the agreed findings were fixed, and a fresh panel reviewed again.

Before and after

Rendered from the real SwiftUI views with fixed sample data (Notchivity --gallery). Click to enlarge.

Dashboard

Columns line up. CI ✓ is grey so each row has one lamp. Amber rows lead with their reason ("2 comments"). Percentages take the bar's colour. A reset weeks away reads "27 Nov", not "Fri".

Errors

A failed account is one row: short reason, fix link under it. Old readings grey out. The PR error has a retry link and no false "0". The header says what "updated" refers to.

Nothing open

The PR column stays where it belongs instead of drifting to the centre, and no "0" sits over "nothing open".

Loading

One "loading…" per column, no third one in the header, and both line up.

Long list

At most two flags on the right; the rest follow the ref. Count sits on the title baseline.

Multi-select

Selection fills reach past the text so ages never touch the edge. The selection line lives in the PR column.

Slack posted

New state: the result sits in the PR column, right where the action was.

Slack failed

New state: a mapped reason, and the selection stays under one hairline for a retry.

Setup checklist

Passing rows step back so failures stand out. "2 to set up" matches the notch label and colour. "close" always works. Short reasons beside their fixes.

Collapsed tab

The all-clear green dot shows in dots mode too. A stale or failing reading greys out instead of posing as live.

Peeks

Headlines lead with the ref. A burst becomes one peek led by the most urgent event, not half a minute of queued peeks.

Settings: General

Lowercase links. Live setup summary. Slack fields save on Return, tab switch, close or quit.

Settings: PRs

Category order is one block under one hairline, with Move Left / Move Right for keyboard and VoiceOver.

Settings: Usage

No more "Code x" wrapping: the account picker moved to Displays as a menu. Names come last with a "rename" placeholder.

Settings: Notifications

Peek duration dims when peeks are off; disabled rows dim their titles.

Settings: Displays

Hover delay sits above the tab section; the tab rows dim when no screen shows the tab.

What changed

Glance

  • Columns are top-aligned, so loading, empty and error states stay in place.
  • One lamp per row: CI ✓ is grey; an amber dot always has an amber reason first.
  • Usage % takes its bar's tone; unknown is "?" (no em dash).
  • Reset times: "HH:mm" today, weekday this week, date beyond.
  • Burst events become one peek led by the worst event; PR headlines lead with the ref.

States

  • No false "0" counts while loading or failing; header freshness names its source.
  • Failed accounts collapse to one row; old readings grey their % and bar (red stays red).
  • Short error text in the narrow column, full sentence in the tooltip, fix as a link.
  • Raw NSError dumps replaced with "unreachable" / "usage fetch failed".

Setup

  • "close" always returns to the dashboard; skipping keeps rechecking every minute.
  • Offline at launch is a warning, not "not signed in"; it never latches setup as passed.
  • "open Claude Code" opens the failing account's CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, and copies the command if Terminal is refused.
  • Fix links give feedback: "copied", "copied, paste in Terminal", "checking…".

Interaction

  • Clicking a peek opens it before hover can expand the panel; a hovered peek never replays.
  • Slack status sits in the PR column; double posts are ignored; failures keep the selection.
  • Select and Cmd-click only exist when Slack is set up.
  • Cmd-W closes Settings, Cmd-1 to Cmd-5 switch tabs; menus use macOS title case.

Settings

  • Data-sized choices use a menu picker; segmented labels never wrap.
  • Slack fields save on Return, tab switch, close or quit, without clobbering hand edits.
  • Disabled rows dim; dependent rows dim with their parent; window tall enough for every tab.

Accessibility

  • PR rows are one button with a full label and Copy URL action; usage rows read as sentences.
  • Collapsed counts, dots and bars have labels; tabs and segments expose selection.
  • Category order can be changed without dragging.

Bugs found along the way

These were in the code before the review started.

  • Peeks read the old value from a willSet publisher, so a new peek could stay hidden and a dismissed one sat empty for a second duration.
  • A rate limit re-polled every 30s forever, keeping the limit alive.
  • "X has N% free" fired at every threshold, across providers, and could point at an account with an expired token.
  • "auth" matched "OAuth" and "author", reporting SSO errors as "gh not signed in".
  • A monthly reset weeks away read as a weekday; tomorrow morning read as a time already past.
  • Approval plus ready raised two back-to-back peeks and banners.

Left as is

  • Default thresholds stay 50 / 75 / 90 / 100 (your choice; a reviewer suggested dropping 50).
  • A 429 right after relaunch waits the full interval; Refresh Now is the manual path.
  • The README's framed hero images were not regenerated; run --screenshots and reframe when you want them current.
  • Nothing was run live: hover, real Keychain and Terminal automation paths were reviewed in code only.
